questions.q:
Given below are two statements :
Statement (I) : Molal depression constant $\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{f}}$ is given by $\frac{M_1 R T_f}{\Delta S_{f u s}}$, where symbols have their usual meaning.
Statement (II) : $\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{f}}$ for benzene is less than the $\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{f}}$ for water.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :
options: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Statement-I
Molar depression constant $\mathrm{k}_f=\frac{\mathrm{M}_1 \mathrm{RT}_{\mathrm{f}}^2}{\Delta \mathrm{H}_{\text {fus }}}$
$\begin{aligned}
& \mathrm{k}_f=\frac{\mathrm{M}_1 \mathrm{RT}_{\mathrm{f}}}{\left[\frac{\Delta \mathrm{H}_{\text {fus }}}{\mathrm{T}_{\mathrm{f}}}\right]} \\
& \mathrm{k}_f=\frac{\mathrm{M}_1 \mathrm{RT}_f}{\Delta \mathrm{~S}_{\text {fus }}}
\end{aligned}$
Hence statement-I is correct
$\text { but } \mathrm{k}_{\mathrm{f}} \text { for benzene }=5.12 \frac{{ }^{\circ} \mathrm{C}}{\mathrm{molal}}$
$\mathrm{k}_{\mathrm{f}}$ for water $=1.86 \frac{{ }^{\circ} \mathrm{C}}{\text { molal }}$ Hence statement- II is incorrect

questions.q:
Evaluate the following statements for their correctness.

A. The elevation in boiling point temperature of water will be same for 0.1 M NaCl and 0.1 M urea.
B. Azeotropic mixture boil without change in their composition.
C. Osmosis always takes place from hypertonic to hypotonic solution.
D. The density of 32% H2SO4 solution having molarity 4.09 M is approximately 1.26 g mL–1.
E. A negatively charged sol is obtained when KI solution is added to silver nitrate solution.

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
(A) Elevation in boiling point (∆Tb) temperature of the water is not same, as ‘i’ value is different for two solutions.
(B) Azeotropic mixture: Liquid mixtures that distill over without changes in composition are called constant boiling mixtures or Azeotropes or Azeotropic mixtures.
(C) Osmosis always takes place from hypotonic (low concentration of solute) solution to hypertonic (high concentration of solute) solution.
(D) Let the mass of H2SO4 (32%) is 100.

∴ Weight of H2SO4 = 32

Moles of H2SO4 = 3298

Now, 4.09 = 3298 × V

⇒ V = 79 mL

Density = 10079 = 1.265
(E) A negative charged sol is obtained when KI solution is added to silver nitrate solution whereas positive charged sol is obtained when AgNO3 solution is added to KI solution.

So, the correct answer is B and D only.

Given mole fraction of liquid 1 in liquid and vapour phase is $x_1$ and $y_1$ respectively.
$\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{P}_1=\mathrm{P}_{\mathrm{T}} y_1=\mathrm{P}_1^0 x_1 \\ & \frac{\mathrm{P}_{\mathrm{T}}}{x_1}=\frac{\mathrm{P}_1^0}{y_1} \\ & \frac{\mathrm{P}_2^0+x_1\left(\mathrm{P}_1^0+\mathrm{P}_2^0\right)}{x_1}=\frac{\mathrm{P}_1^0}{y_1} \\ & \frac{\mathrm{P}_2^0}{x_1}+\left(\mathrm{P}_1^0+\mathrm{P}_2^0\right)=\frac{\mathrm{P}_1^0}{y_1} \\ & \frac{\mathrm{P}_2^0}{x_1}=\frac{\mathrm{P}_1^0}{y_1}-\left(\mathrm{P}_1^0+\mathrm{P}_2^0\right) \\ & \frac{1}{x_1}=\frac{1}{y_2}\left(\frac{\mathrm{P}_1^0}{\mathrm{P}_2^0}\right)-\frac{\left(\mathrm{P}_1^0+\mathrm{P}_2^0\right)}{\mathrm{P}_2^0}\end{aligned}\begin{aligned} & \frac{1}{x_1}=\frac{1}{y_2}\left(\frac{P_1^0}{P_2^0}\right)+\frac{\left(P_2^0-P_1^0\right)}{P_2^0} \\ & y=m x+c \\ & \text { Slope }=\frac{P_1^0}{P_2^0} ; \text { Intercept }=\frac{P_2^0-P_1^0}{P_2^0}\end{aligned}$
